## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Target branch

- [ ] This pull request targets `development`.
- [ ] If it targets `main`, it is a reviewed release or urgent production fix.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant R tests pass.
- [ ] Example workflow or notebook cells were run where appropriate.
- [ ] Statistical settings, random seeds, and simulation counts are documented.
- [ ] New input data or external records include provenance.
- [ ] Generated outputs were reviewed for size and relevance.

## Interpretation boundary

- [ ] Biological annotation remains separate from statistical significance.
- [ ] Small exploratory simulations are not presented as final inference.

## Reviewer notes

Call out assumptions, known limitations, or decisions requiring special review.
